snippet.title: The Other Side of the Wall Mystery Point and Click Teaser
snippet.description:
Julian Reed is a 13-year old student at a New England all-boys Catholic boarding school in the early 1980s. When people begin disappearing and no one else seems to remember they ever existed, Julian investigates, with the help of a girl he has never seen, separated from him by a wall.

Steam Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4139900/The_Other_Side_of_the_Wall/
